examples.en: I'm afraid the shop closes in five minutes.
examples.cn: 恐怕商店五分钟后就要关门了。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses move from terror of a thing, to worry about an outcome, to a polite phrase that borrows a little fear.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项从对某物的惊恐，走到对结果的担忧，再到借一点「怕」的客气说法。

branches.en: real fear, forward-looking worry, and borrowed politeness
branches.cn: 真实的恐惧、向前的担忧，以及借来的客气

intro.cn: 一个表示「使害怕」的法语动词、它的分词，以及英语里由 fear 构成的亲属词。

definition_zh: 在……之后；在……后面；追赶；后来（副词、连词）
definition_en: later than a time or event, behind someone or something, in pursuit of, or afterwards as an adverb or conjunction
core_image: 一列脚印从门口延伸出去，渐渐被落雪盖住
scene: 客人们在午夜过后才陆续离开。The guests left soon after midnight.
sceneCN: 这里的 after 是「在……之后」（第 1 个义项：时间上晚于某一点）；句意是客人们在午夜刚过不久就离开了。

pos.zh: 介词：在……之后；在……后面；追赶
连词：在……之后
副词：后来；之后

derivatives.zh: after 加 noon 构成，义为「下午」
after 加 math「割草」构成，义为「后果；余波」
after 加 -ward 构成，义为「后来」
afterward 加复数 -s 构成，义为「后来」（英式常用）

senses.title: Later than a time
senses.definition: at a time later than an event, hour, or period
senses.definitionCN: 在某个事件、时刻或时期之后的时间
senses.example: The guests left soon after midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 客人们在午夜刚过不久就离开了。
senses.why: Old English æfter marked what comes later in time or order; the temporal sense is the oldest and still the commonest.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 æfter 标记在时间或次序上较晚的一方；时间义最古老，也仍是最常用的。

senses.title: Behind in place or order
senses.titleCN: 在……后面；在……之后（位置或顺序）
senses.definition: behind someone or something in position, or following them in a sequence
senses.definitionCN: 在某人某物的位置之后，或在序列中紧随其后
senses.example: Your name comes after mine on the list.
senses.exampleCN: 名单上你的名字排在我的后面。
senses.why: Spatial order and temporal order share one word: what is behind you is also what comes later along the same line.
senses.whyCN: 空间次序与时间次序共用一个词：在你身后之物，也是沿同一条线较晚到来之物。

senses.title: In pursuit of
senses.definition: following someone in order to catch them, or trying to obtain something
senses.definitionCN: 跟在某人后面想抓住他，或努力想得到某物
senses.example: The dog ran after the postman.
senses.exampleCN: 狗追着邮递员跑。
senses.why: If you keep behind a moving person, the same position becomes a chase; the verb before it turns space into pursuit.
senses.whyCN: 如果你一直跟在移动的人后面，同一个位置就变成追逐；前面的动词把空间关系变成了追捕。

senses.title: Afterwards, as adverb or conjunction
senses.definition: used alone as an adverb, or before a clause as a conjunction, to mean later
senses.definitionCN: 单独作副词，或引导从句作连词，表示「后来、在……之后」
senses.example: We had dinner and went for a walk after.
senses.exampleCN: 我们吃了晚饭，之后去散了步。
senses.why: Once the word can stand without an object, it turns from a preposition into an adverb or conjunction marking sequence.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词可以不带宾语单独站立，它就从介词转为副词或连词，标记先后顺序。

intro.en: A Germanic word of position and sequence, unchanged in meaning for more than a thousand years.
intro.cn: 一个日耳曼语的方位与顺序词，一千多年来意思几乎没有变。

items.en: The reconstructed form after meant behind or later, and it underlies German after and Dutch achter.
items.cn: 重构形式 after 意为「在后面、较晚」，它支撑德语 after 与荷兰语 achter。

items.en: Old English æfter covered both place and time, and also meant in pursuit of.
items.cn: 古英语 æfter 兼指位置与时间，还表示「追赶」。

items.en: Old Norse eptir reinforced the same senses in the north of England.
items.cn: 古诺尔斯语 eptir 在英格兰北部强化了同样的义项。

items.en: Middle English after kept the preposition and grew the adverb use; compounds such as afternoon appeared.
items.cn: 中古英语 after 保留介词用法，并发展出副词用法；afternoon 等复合词开始出现。

items.en: The spelling has not changed since, and the word now anchors a large set of compounds and phrasal verbs.
items.cn: 此后拼写未再变化，这个词如今支撑着一大批复合词与短语动词。

note.en: The first group is built on after; the second gathers words for later and behind.
note.cn: 第一组由 after 构成；第二组收表示「较晚」与「在后面」的词。

entries.definition: the part of the day between noon and evening
the situation left after a bad event
at a later time
at the back of a ship; looks similar but is a nautical term
entries.definitionCN: 在船尾；拼写相近，却是航海术语

entries.definition: at the back of someone or something
coming after something in time or order

normalIntro.en: One Germanic word covers time, place, and pursuit; the compounds show how far it reaches.
normalIntro.cn: 一个日耳曼词同时管时间、位置与追赶；一串复合词显出它的触角有多长。

normal.en: after covers later in time, behind in place, and in pursuit.
normal.cn: after 同时表示时间较晚、位置在后、以及追赶。

normal.en: The word can stand alone as an adverb: we left soon after.
normal.cn: 它可以单独作副词：we left soon after。

normal.en: afternoon and aftermath are old compounds with after first.
normal.cn: afternoon 与 aftermath 都是 after 在前的旧复合词。

normal.en: look after means care for, not look behind.
normal.cn: look after 是照顾，不是往后面看。

normal.en: Spell it with -fter, not -ghter.
normal.cn: 拼写是 -fter，不是 -ghter。

abstract.en: Picture footprints leaving a door and slowly filling with snow.
abstract.cn: 想象脚印从门口延伸出去，渐渐被雪填满。

abstract.en: See a name placed one line below another on a list.
abstract.cn: 想象名单上一个名字排在另一个下面一行。

abstract.en: Imagine a dog keeping exactly one step behind a running postman.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狗恰好落后邮递员一步紧追。

examples.cn: 客人们在午夜刚过不久就离开了。

examples.en: Your name comes after mine on the list.
examples.cn: 名单上你的名字排在我的后面。

examples.en: The dog ran after the postman.
examples.cn: 狗追着邮递员跑。

root: 古英语 æfter 来自原始日耳曼语 after，本兼指「在后面」与「较晚」，并含「追赶」义；古诺尔斯语 eptir 在英格兰北部强化了这些用法，现代英语基本沿用。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses spread one idea of being behind: behind in time, behind in place, behind in a chase, and standing alone as 'later'.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项展开同一个「在后」的念头：时间在后、位置在后、追在身后，以及单独表示「后来」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of footprints leaving a door and filling with snow.
core.cn: 核心意象：一串脚印从门口延伸出去，被雪填满。

branches.en: guests leaving just past midnight
branches.cn: 午夜刚过就离开的客人

branches.cn: 名单上排在下面的名字

branches.en: a dog chasing a postman
branches.cn: 追着邮递员的狗

branches.en: dinner, and a walk afterwards
branches.cn: 晚饭，以及之后的散步

branches.cn: 同一个「在后」，读作时间、空间、追赶或顺序

intro.cn: 一个古英语词，如今在一大批复合词里充当前缀。

definition_zh: （战争、灾难等的）后果；余波；（农业）再生草
definition_en: the situation or consequences left after a damaging event, or in farming, a second crop of grass grown after mowing
core_image: 洪水退去的街道上，泥浆、断枝和倒下的招牌摊了一地
scene: 风暴过去两天，渔港的水面仍漂着碎木板。The village is still clearing up the aftermath of the flood.
sceneCN: 这里的 aftermath 是「后果、余波」（第 1 个义项：灾祸之后留下的局面）；句意是村子仍在清理洪水留下的残局。

pos.zh: 名词：后果；余波；再生草

derivatives.zh: 复合词的前半部分，义为「在……之后」
复数形式，义为「多次灾祸的余波」

senses.title: The consequences of a damaging event
senses.definition: the situation that remains after a war, disaster, or other damaging event
senses.definitionCN: 战争、灾难或其他破坏性事件之后留下的局面
senses.example: The village is still clearing up the aftermath of the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 村子仍在清理洪水留下的残局。
senses.why: The word first meant grass cut after the main harvest; that second cutting became a picture of what grows or remains after the main event.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指主收割之后割下的一茬草；这「第二茬」逐渐成了主事件之后长出的、留下之物的图景。

senses.title: A second crop of grass
senses.definition: in farming, grass that grows again after a field has been mown
senses.definitionCN: 农耕中，田地割过之后重新长出的草
senses.example: The farmer cut the aftermath for hay in late summer.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫在夏末把再生草割下做干草。
senses.why: This is the original sense, still used in agriculture: the crop that follows the first cutting of a field.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的本义，农业中仍在使用：一块田第一次割过之后又收的那一茬。

intro.en: An old farming word about a second mowing, which became a word for what follows a disaster.
intro.cn: 一个关于「第二茬割草」的古老农事词，后来变成指灾后遗留局面的词。

items.en: mæth meant a mowing or a crop of grass, related to the verb mawan, to mow.
items.cn: mæth 意为「割草、一茬草」，与动词 mawan「割」同源。

items.en: æfter meant after or behind, and was freely joined to nouns to mark what comes later.
items.cn: æfter 意为「在……之后、在后」，常与名词组合以标记较晚的一方。

items.en: aftermath named the grass that grew after the first mowing was taken.
items.cn: aftermath 指第一次割草收走之后又长出的草。

items.en: Writers began using the word figuratively for any second growth or consequence.
items.cn: 十六世纪起，作家开始把这个词比喻地用于任何「后续的生长」或后果。

items.en: In modern use the figurative sense dominates, almost always in the pattern in the aftermath of something bad.
items.cn: 现代用法中比喻义占主导，几乎总出现在 in the aftermath of 某个坏事的句框里。

note.en: The first group shares the after- element; the second gathers words for consequences and destruction.
note.cn: 第一组共享 after- 成分；第二组收表示「后果」与「破坏」的词。

at a later time

entries.definitionCN: 美式口语的「数学」；在此词里旧义是「割草」

entries.definition: a result of an action or event

normal.en: Think of math as mowing here, not arithmetic.
normal.cn: 这里的 math 要理解成「割草」，不是算术。

normal.en: The literal aftermath is the second crop of hay.
normal.cn: 字面的 aftermath 是第二茬干草。

normal.en: The figurative aftermath is what is left after a disaster.

normal.en: Spell it as after plus math, with no hyphen.
normal.cn: 拼写就是 after 加 math，中间不加连字符。

abstract.en: Picture a field just mown, with short green shoots already pushing up.
abstract.cn: 想象刚割过的田里，短短的新绿已经冒头。

abstract.en: See the same field after a flood, covered in mud instead of grass.
abstract.cn: 想象同一块田被洪水淹过，铺满泥浆而非青草。

abstract.en: Imagine a second growth of any kind: grass, rubble, or rumour.
abstract.cn: 想象任何一种「第二茬」：青草、瓦砾或流言。

examples.en: Hospitals struggled in the aftermath of the earthquake.
examples.cn: 地震之后，医院在余波中艰难运转。

examples.en: The government faced criticism in the immediate aftermath of the vote.
examples.cn: 投票刚结束的那段时间，政府就面临批评。

examples.en: The farmer sold the aftermath as winter feed.
examples.cn: 农夫把再生草当作冬季饲料卖掉。

sensesIntro.en: The literal sense is a second crop of grass; the figurative sense is the second growth of a disaster.
sensesIntro.cn: 字面义是第二茬青草，比喻义是灾难之后长出的「第二茬」局面。

definition_zh: 下午；午后；（问候语）午安

scene: 考试安排在下午，教室里安静得能听见钟摆。The lecture starts at three in the afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里的 afternoon 是「下午」（第 1 个义项：正午到傍晚之间的一段时间）；句意是讲座在下午三点开始。

pos.zh: 名词：下午；午后
感叹词：午安（问候语）

derivatives.zh: 复合词的前半部分，义为「在……之后」

senses.title: The time after noon
senses.definition: the period of the day between noon and evening
senses.definitionCN: 正午到傍晚之间的那段时间
senses.example: The lecture starts at three in the afternoon.

senses.title: A midday greeting
senses.definition: used in the phrase good afternoon as a polite greeting after midday
senses.definitionCN: 用于 good afternoon 这一短语，作为午后的礼貌问候
senses.example: Good afternoon, everyone; thank you for coming.
senses.exampleCN: 大家下午好，感谢各位前来。
senses.why: The time of day becomes a form of greeting, as with good morning and good evening; the noun turns into a salutation.
senses.whyCN: 一天中的时段变成了问候语，一如 good morning 与 good evening；名词于是转为致意之辞。

intro.en: Two plain words joined: after, and noon, which once meant the ninth hour.
intro.cn: 两个普通词拼在一起：after，以及原本指「第九时」的 noon。

items.en: nona hora was the ninth hour of the Roman day, about three in the afternoon.
items.cn: nona hora 是罗马白天的第九时，约相当于下午三点。

items.en: Old English non borrowed the church's noon service and used it for the middle of the day.
items.cn: 古英语 non 借自教会的「午间礼拜」，用来指一天的中段。

items.en: By Middle English noon had shifted to twelve o'clock, the boundary after which the afternoon begins.
items.cn: 到中古英语，noon 已移到十二点，成为下午开始的界线。

items.en: English simply joined after to noon to name the hours that follow midday.
items.cn: 英语直接把 after 与 noon 拼合，用来命名正午之后的几个小时。

items.en: The compound is now the ordinary word for the period, and good afternoon is a fixed greeting.
items.cn: 这个复合词如今是这一时段的常用说法，good afternoon 则是固定问候语。

note.en: The first group shares the after- element; the second gathers other parts of the day.
note.cn: 第一组共享 after- 成分；第二组收一天中的其他时段。

definition_zh: 后来；之后；事后
definition_en: at a time later than an event, especially in the sequence of a narrative
core_image: 雨停之后，屋檐还在一滴一滴地落水
scene: 会议在十点结束，大家陆续走出大楼。We went for coffee afterward.
sceneCN: 这里的 afterward 是「后来、之后」（第 1 个义项：某件事结束以后的时间）；句意是会后我们去喝了咖啡。

pos.zh: 副词：后来；之后；事后

senses.title: At a later time
senses.definition: at a time following an event that has just been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 在刚提到的某件事之后的时间里
senses.example: We went for coffee afterward.
senses.exampleCN: 会后我们去喝了咖啡。
senses.why: after marks what is behind in time, and -ward adds direction: the word points the mind forward to the time that follows.
senses.whyCN: after 标记时间上在后，-ward 加方向：这个词把心思指向接续而来的那段时间。

senses.title: Looking back after the event
senses.definition: used when a later understanding or judgment is contrasted with what was known at the time
senses.definitionCN: 用于把事后才有的理解或判断与当时所知相对照
senses.example: Only afterward did I realise what the warning meant.
senses.exampleCN: 事后我才明白那个警告是什么意思。
senses.why: Placed at the head of a sentence or after only, the word marks the gap between the event and the understanding that came later.
senses.whyCN: 放在句首或 only 之后时，这个词标出事件与事后才产生的理解之间的那段间隔。

intro.en: Old English after plus the directional ending -weard, meaning turned towards what comes next.
intro.cn: 古英语 after 加方向词尾 -weard，意为「朝向接续而来的方向」。

items.en: æfter meant after or behind, covering both time and place.
items.cn: æfter 意为「在……之后、在后面」，兼指时间与位置。

items.en: The suffix -weard meant turned towards, as in toward and homeward.
items.cn: 词尾 -weard 意为「朝向」，如 toward 与 homeward。

items.en: afterward was formed as 'in the direction of after', that is, towards a later time.
items.cn: afterward 由「朝着 after 的方向」构成，即朝向较晚的时间。

items.en: The adverb is recorded from the thirteenth century, often at the end of a clause.
items.cn: 这个副词自十三世纪有记录，常放在从句末尾。

items.en: American English prefers afterward, while British English equally uses afterwards.
items.cn: 美式英语偏好 afterward，英式英语则同样常用 afterwards。

note.en: The first group looks alike and shares the after element; the second gathers adverbs of later time.
note.cn: 第一组拼写相近且共享 after 成分；第二组收表示「较晚时间」的副词。

normal.en: Do not confuse afterward with afterword, a book's closing note.
normal.cn: 别把 afterward 与书末的 afterword「后记」混了。

senses.title: At a time following an event
senses.definition: after something has happened, used especially in British English to place an action later
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生之后，尤用于英式英语，把动作放到较晚的时间
senses.example: We talked about the play for hours afterwards.
senses.exampleCN: 演出之后我们聊了好几个小时。
senses.why: The -s form began as a genitive adverb, 'of after', and settled into a plain marker of later time.
senses.whyCN: 带 -s 的形式最初是属格副词，意为「在后的那一侧」，后来固定为纯粹的「较晚时间」标记。

senses.title: In hindsight, after the event
senses.definition: used to contrast what is known now with what was not known during the event
senses.definitionCN: 用于把现在所知与事件当时所不知相对照
senses.example: Afterwards, she could see that the signs had been there all along.
senses.exampleCN: 事后她才看出，那些迹象一直就在那里。
senses.why: At the head of a sentence the adverb frames the whole scene as already finished, which produces the hindsight reading.
senses.whyCN: 放在句首时，这个副词把整个场景框定为已经结束，于是产生「事后回顾」的读法。

intro.en: The British twin of afterward, carrying an old adverbial -s.

items.en: æfter meant after or behind, covering time and place.

items.en: A genitive -es was added to afterward, giving afterwardes, 'of the after side'.
items.cn: afterward 后加上属格 -es，形成 afterwardes，意为「在后的那一侧」。

items.en: The -s form competed with afterward for centuries and became standard in British writing.
items.cn: 带 -s 的形式与 afterward 竞争了数百年，最终在英式书面语中成为标准。

items.en: British English uses both forms, preferring afterwards in speech; American English prefers afterward.
items.cn: 英式英语两种形式都用，口语中偏爱 afterwards；美式英语则偏爱 afterward。
